tools.name: estimate_budget
tools.title: What a budget usually returns
tools.description: Estimates what spending a budget on one pack usually returns: how many packs it buys, the average insured value pulled, the average cash back if every card is sold back, the average result, and the chance of at least one Rare or Epic. Use it when the user asks what to expect from spending an amount, or whether a pack is worth it; use get_pack for the pack's odds and top cards. Read-only; honest averages from Collector Crypt's live odds, not a promise, and real results swing a lot with few packs.

code.description: Pack code from list_packs, lowercase, e.g. pokemon_50, onepiece_250, soccer_100.

budget.description: Budget in US$, e.g. 250. Must cover at least one pack.

tools.name: get_card
tools.title: One card in detail
tools.description: Shows one Rare or Epic card that is in a pack pool right now: name, insured value, picture, and every pack it can come from with that pack's price and the chance per pack of pulling this exact card. Use it after search_cards, passing the nft field of a result; use search_cards when you only have a card name. Read-only; fails with a clear message if the card has just been pulled and left the pool.

nft.description: The card's NFT address (Solana, base58) from a search_cards result, e.g. 7xKX...q9Fz.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.title: One pack in detail
tools.description: Shows one pack in detail: odds and value range per rarity, buyback rate, how many cards of each rarity are left, and the 10 most valuable cards in its pool right now with the chance per pack of pulling each one. Use it when the user names or picks a pack; use list_packs to compare packs and estimate_budget to see what spending a set amount on this pack usually returns. Read-only; pool cards are rescanned every few minutes and can be pulled by anyone at any time.

code.description: Pack code from list_packs, lowercase, e.g. pokemon_50, onepiece_250, soccer_100.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.title: List the packs
tools.description: Lists every live Collector Crypt graded-card pack with price, category, chance of each rarity, card value range per rarity, buyback rate, average value per dollar and popularity (pulls in the last 7 days), most popular first. Use it first to compare packs or to find a pack code; use get_pack for one pack's top cards and cards left, and search_cards to look for a specific card. Read-only, no sign-in; numbers are Collector Crypt's live mainnet data, at most 5 minutes old.

category.description: Only packs of this category. 'Others' covers Lorcana, Riftbound, Dragon Ball and anime. Leave out for all packs.

tools.name: list_recent_pulls
tools.title: What people just pulled
tools.description: Lists the newest pack openings on Collector Crypt across every site that sells its packs, newest first (from the latest ~200): card, insured value, rarity, pack and its price, how many times the pack price the card was worth, and when. Use it to show what people are really getting right now, optionally for one pack, one rarity or above a value; use search_cards for cards still waiting in a pool. Read-only; the feed is at most 30 seconds old and wallets are shortened.

code.description: Pack code from list_packs, lowercase, e.g. pokemon_50, onepiece_250, soccer_100.

rarity.description: Only pulls of this rarity, e.g. epic.

min_value.description: Only cards worth at least this many US$, e.g. 100.

limit.description: How many pulls to return, 1 to 50 (default 20).

tools.name: search_cards
tools.title: Find a card in the packs
tools.description: Finds Rare and Epic cards sitting in any pack's pool right now by name words and/or minimum value (e.g. 'charizard psa 10'), up to 25, most valuable first, with the pack each is in and the chance per pack of pulling that exact card. Use it when the user asks whether a card can be pulled or which pack holds the best cards; use get_card for one result's full detail (pass its nft) and list_recent_pulls for cards already pulled. Read-only; pools are rescanned every few minutes, Commons and Uncommons aren't indexed.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the card name, any order, e.g. 'umbreon vmax' or 'psa 10 rookie'.

min_value.description: Only cards worth at least this many US$, e.g. 500.

category.description: Only packs of this category. 'Others' covers Lorcana, Riftbound, Dragon Ball and anime. Leave out for all packs.
